This appears to be a sulfonamide linking aromatic ring to another aromatic ring bearing a cinnamic acid (alpha,beta-unsaturated carboxylic acid). The Doebner modification would be formation of that C=C and carboxylic acid from aldehyde + malonic acid. So retrosynthetic step would break the C=C bond and the C-O bond (carboxyl) and a C-C bond? Actually decarboxylation yields unsaturated acid from aldehyde + malonic acid, losing CO2. So the precursor would be aromatic aldehyde (with sulfonamide) and malonic acid? The product is the cinnamic acid attached to sulfonyl phenyl. So the precursor likely is "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1" (aryl aldehyde) plus "HOOC-CH2-COOH". However the template may be generic for Doebner modification.
